name: sitesplat/imgur
description: Imgur - forum images uploader allows the upload of forum images via the image host service IMGUR - Please note, You will need to register an Imgur app to get the Client ID needed for this extension to work. For creating a new App go to https://api.imgur.com/oauth2/addclient and register it following the instruction provided. Use the client ID under ACP > Postings > Attachment settings: Imgur Client ID
